proofScope.covers: Pre-release identifiers that are numeric must be compared as integers, not lexicographically, per SemVer 2.0.0 §11.
cases: compareVersions('1.0.0-alpha.10', '1.0.0-alpha.2') === 1 (reported example)
compareVersions('1.0.0-1', '1.0.0-2') === -1 (numeric ids: 1 < 2)
compareVersions('1.0.0-2', '1.0.0-10') === -1 (numeric ids: 2 < 10)
compareVersions('1.0.0-10', '1.0.0-2') === 1 (numeric ids: 10 > 2)
compareVersions('1.0.0-alpha', '1.0.0-beta') === -1 (lexical for non-numeric)
compareVersions('1.0.0-1', '1.0.0-alpha') === -1 (numeric id < alphanumeric id)
compareVersions('1.0.0-alpha', '1.0.0-alpha.1') === -1 (shorter pre-release < longer)
compareVersions('1.0.0-alpha.1', '1.0.0-alpha.1') === 0 (equal pre-release)
